passives.name: Arc Chain
passives.description: Attacks chain lightning to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 45% damage to each.

passives.name: Frostbite
passives.description: Hits chill enemies, slowing them by 35% for 2 seconds. Chilled enemies take +10% damage.

passives.name: Crimson Edge
passives.description: Melee attacks inflict deep wounds that bleed for 25% of attack damage per second for 3.5s.

passives.name: Armor Piercing
passives.description: Projectiles punch through 2 additional enemies. Pierced targets take full damage.

passives.name: Echo Strike
passives.description: Every 3rd attack echoes instantly, dealing 65% bonus damage as a phantom strike.

passives.name: Shockwave
passives.description: Melee impacts release a crushing wave that hits all enemies within 150px for 35% damage.

passives.name: Soulrend
passives.description: Melee attacks drain life force, healing you for 30% of damage dealt.

passives.name: Double Tap
passives.description: Fire a second shot at the same target, dealing 70% damage. Both can crit.

passives.name: Fan of Blades
passives.description: Attacks spray 3 additional projectiles at nearby enemies for 55% damage each.

passives.name: Ricochet
passives.description: Projectiles bounce to the nearest enemy on hit, dealing 75% damage. Can chain once.

passives.name: Executioner
passives.description: Targets below 25% HP are marked for death. Attacks against marked targets deal +50% damage.

passives.name: Hex Bomb
passives.description: Hits plant an unstable hex. If the target dies within 2s, it explodes for 80% AoE damage.

passives.name: Temporal Rift
passives.description: Attacks create time fractures that slow all nearby enemies by 30% for 1 second.

passives.name: Shadowstep
passives.description: Every 3rd melee hit, blink through the enemy, becoming briefly invulnerable.

passives.name: Stun Lock
passives.description: Hits stagger enemies, reducing their movement by 60% for 0.5 seconds.

passives.name: Overcharge
passives.description: Every 4th hit releases a massive arc to 2 random nearby enemies for 45% damage each.

passives.name: Marked for Death
passives.description: Projectiles mark targets. Your next hit consumes the mark for 50% bonus damage.

passives.name: Gravity Well
passives.description: Hits create vortex zones. When 3+ enemies cluster in a zone, they take 35% AoE damage.

passives.name: Inferno Brand
passives.description: Attacks ignite enemies, burning them for 20% of attack damage per second for 4 seconds.

passives.name: Life Steal
passives.description: Projectile hits heal the attacker for 20% of damage dealt. Crits heal double.

passives.name: Doom Mark
passives.description: Attacks stack Doom (max 4). At 4 stacks, detonate for 100% bonus damage + AoE explosion.

passives.name: Shatter
passives.description: Attacking chilled enemies shatters the ice, dealing 55% AoE damage and spreading the chill.

passives.name: Apex Predator
passives.description: Deal +35% damage to enemies above 75% HP. Perfect for opening strikes.

passives.name: Berserker
passives.description: Below 50% HP, gain +40% attack speed and +20% damage. The lower your HP, the stronger.

passives.name: Chain Reaction
passives.description: Kills trigger explosions that deal 60% damage to nearby enemies. Can chain infinitely.

passives.name: Glass Cannon
passives.description: Deal +50% damage, but take +25% damage. High risk, high reward.

passives.name: Phantom Strike
passives.description: 20% chance for attacks to strike twice instantly. The phantom hit can crit.

passives.name: Toxic Venom
passives.description: Attacks apply deadly venom: 15% damage/sec for 5s. Venom stacks up to 3 times.

passives.name: Explosive Rounds
passives.description: Projectiles explode on impact, dealing 40% AoE damage in a 60px radius.

passives.name: Chain Master
passives.description: Chain Lightning weapons bounce 2 extra times with 15% less decay.

passives.name: Scatter Specialist
passives.description: Scatter Shot weapons fire 2 extra projectiles with tighter spread.

passives.name: Chakram Mastery
passives.description: Boomerangs travel 50% further and return damage is increased to 100%.

passives.name: Beam Focus
passives.description: Beam attacks last 50% longer and grow 25% wider over time.

passives.name: Aftershock
passives.description: Ground Slams create a second shockwave after 0.5s dealing 50% damage.

passives.name: Permafrost
passives.description: Frost weapons slow 20% more and frozen enemies shatter on death for 70% AoE.

passives.name: Virulent Plague
passives.description: Poison DOTs spread to nearby enemies and deal 30% more damage.

passives.name: Wildfire
passives.description: Fire damage spreads to 2 nearby enemies. Burning enemies take 25% more damage.

passives.name: Orbital Precision
passives.description: Orbital Strikes charge 40% faster and deal 30% more damage to clustered enemies.

passives.name: Reaper's Hunger
passives.description: Reaper Slash heals for 15% of total damage dealt. Killing blows heal double.

passives.name: Demolition Expert
passives.description: Bombs have 30% larger explosion radius and leave burning ground for 2s.

passives.name: Pinball Wizard
passives.description: Ricochet bullets bounce 3 more times with no damage decay.

passives.name: Spirit Surge
passives.description: Delayed strikes spawn 2 additional phantom lances on marked targets.

passives.name: Blood Lord
passives.description: Lifesteal increased by 15%. Overheal creates a shield equal to 50% excess.

passives.name: Silken Snare
passives.description: Hits entangle enemies, slowing them by 55% for 1.2s. Cannot trigger more than once every 0.35s.

passives.name: Spore Bloom
passives.description: On hit, release a spore burst that poisons nearby enemies for 22% damage per second for 3s.

passives.name: Gel Mitosis
passives.description: Every 4th hit splits into 2 gel bolts that strike nearby enemies for 45% damage.
